title: Quadrilaterals and Polygons
summary: The quadrilateral family and its properties, and the angle sums of polygons.

ib.note: Classifying quadrilaterals by properties is MYP 3 Geometry

objectives: I can describe the properties of special quadrilaterals.
I can explain how quadrilaterals are related (e.g. every square is a rectangle).
I can find interior and exterior angles of polygons.
misconceptions: A square is not a rectangle.
The diagonals of every parallelogram are equal.
Angle sums are the same for all polygons.
